title: Netflix Releases Official Season 3 Trailer for Highly Anticipated Series 'Graveyard'
body_markdown:
Netflix has released the official season 3 trailer for the highly anticipated series


Graveyard


, directed by


Abdullah Oğuz


, starring


Birce Akalay


and


Olgun Toker


. The new season reunites Inspector Önem and her team, and will premiere only on Netflix, on


August 28


.


To download new images from the series, click


[HERE](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1KjVdfxEG0ODdC-UWVuD8mpvmMnS6bi7H?usp=drive_link)


To download the first images from the series, click


[HERE](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/18SZXknXedvqtdBEH648KB-3heMt1ngq6?usp=drive_link)


The series is produced by


Abdullah Oğuz


and


Evren Oğuz


, with


Abdullah Oğuz


and


Ömer Baykul


sharing directing duties on the new season. The screenplay is written by


Fulya Turhan


,


Ahmet Saatçioğlu


, and


Evren Oğuz


. The cast of the third season includes


Birce Akalay


and


Olgun Toker,


joined by


Şehsuvar Aktaş, Hakan Meriçliler, Sezgin Uzunbekiroğlu, Cem Sürgit, Baran Güler, Arbil Tabur, Yeşim Çelebi, Elif Sevinç


, and


Berke Gündem


.


The team reunites to uncover the truth behind the mysterious boxes sent to women, embarking on the search for a shocking truth in the new season of Graveyard. Inspector Önem, meanwhile, finds both her team and herself at the center of a dark threat.


About


Graveyard


Season 3:


When a disturbing new case draws the disbanded Graveyard team back together, Önem’s unexpected return to duty turns the investigation into a personal and shattering process for the team.


Writers:


Fulya Turhan, Ahmet Saatçioğlu, Evren Oğuz


Directors:


Abdullah Oğuz, Ömer Baykul


Producers:


Abdullah Oğuz, Evren Oğuz


Production Company:


ANS / Evrensel Productions


Cast:


Birce Akalay, Olgun Toker, Şehsuvar Aktaş, Hakan Meriçliler, Sezgin Uzunbekiroğlu, Cem Sürgit, Baran Güler, Arbil Tabur, Yeşim Çelebi, Elif Sevinç, Berke Gündem
